description: Combine the robust fast-n=32 four-size solver with the n=352 column-packed paired-reflector phases: preserve the 29-family n=32 classifier and n=512 packed/refinement paths, reconcile cooperative reducer and extension symbols, retain n=176 exact behavior, then profile all custom sizes and stress n=352 spectra plus selective certificate fallback.

Integrated the robust 29-family n32 four-size parent with the n352 two-CTA packed clustered reducer, column-packed reflectors, separated specialized Sturm/inverse phases, and paired-reflector backtransform. Build and all 39 official tests pass. Full geomean improves from parent 39012.589 to 37862.933 us; n32=68.725, n176=994.921, n352=6578.098, and n512 terms remain 118560/151841/152583/122943/97363 us.

Removed the now-unreachable dense n352 reducer after the cooperative packed reducer fully replaced it, eliminating 121 conflicting legacy CUDA lines while preserving the n512 generic packed reducer. Build and all 39 tests pass; full geomean remeasured 37835.652 us, with n32=68.710, n176=991.553, n352=6577.836, and n512 terms unchanged within noise. The earlier 33-family n352 raw-certificate/repair sweep also passed all families with 60/66 matrices selectively repaired.

Final commit f9d8319c41e08500a7870cf40a4ec4697352fd06 combines the robust four-size solver with the n352 two-CTA packed reducer, column-packed reflectors, separated specialized Sturm/inverse iteration, and paired-reflector backtransform, while preserving the n32 29-family classifier, exact n176 path, and n512 packed/refinement dispatch. Both trials pass all 39 official tests; final geomean is 37835.652 us versus first-parent 39012.589, with n32=68.710, n176=991.553, n352=6577.836, and n512=118457/151982/152650/123003/97415 us. A 33-family n352 raw-certificate sweep passed every FP64 check after selective repair, with 60/66 matrices flagged and ordinary dense/band cases also exercising un-repaired output. Final-SHA profiles cover all four custom sizes: n32 fused/classifier 59.710/4.015 us; n176 reducer/solve 467.897/394.138 us; n352 reducer/backtransform/Sturm/inverse/coupling 3591.342/886.887/152.291/91.692/10.540 us; n512 reducer/solve 55.015/18.928 ms. Continue with block-four compact-WY reflector grouping, asynchronous coupling/Sturm overlap, or a new cooperative n352 reducer structure; the current n352 reducer remains the dominant 3.59 ms phase.
